title: Render the strict literal Plant Feed union

gates.name: plant_feed_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/plant-feed.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser verification covers every UIFeedEventV1 variant, pagination/retry, literal markup/prompt/URL-looking text, zero active element/action parsing, and unchanged presentation-only flags/authority.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-006 RED: no Svelte DOM consumer currently proves literal inert rendering; GREEN: all registered Feed text variants preserve exact visible strings without HTML/Markdown/link/action semantics; decisive comparison: response text versus DOM structure/events/navigation/request log; artifact: literal Feed evidence under .tasks/TASK-086-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Create the only human Feed consumer while preserving UI Feed isolation, Safety/Advisor read-only presentation, and literal candidate-text semantics.
success_outcome: The Plant workspace renders the exact paginated UIFeedEventV1 union as inert Svelte text, including Safety/Advisor/Companion presentation, without creating links, commands, approval, publication, or agent context.
anti_goals: Do not add raw HTML, Markdown, automatic URL linking, command parsing, arbitrary chat submission, or direct agent invocation.
Do not treat Safety/Advisor/Companion Feed data as approval, Task, governance command, Plant fact, or agent input.

forbidden_scope: direct Feed persistence or introduction materialization
stop_conditions: A registered Feed variant cannot be rendered without interpreting its text as executable markup/action data.
The PWA needs a direct Agent Chat Bus, Safety, or provider boundary.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Agent Chat & UI Feed remains the only Feed provider.
Use Svelte interpolation/text nodes for every untrusted string and exact union discrimination for payloads.
invariants: UI Feed remains unavailable as agent working context and grants no Safety, Task, governance, or Dataset authority.
Markup-, prompt-, command-, and URL-looking candidate text remains inert visible data.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-006: every representative string produces no active element, link, command, navigation, or action side effect.
T3 harm proof covers all union variants in isolated Feed state and verifies safe rerun/retry without duplicate authority or unsafe DOM residue.
